create_sampleframe_from_dataframe: create a SampleFrame from a pandas DataFrame with auto-detected id, weight, and covariate columns
trim_weights_in_sampleframe: trim extreme weights in a SampleFrame using mean-ratio clipping or percentile winsorization
set_weights_on_sampleframe: set or replace the active weight column values on a SampleFrame with a Series or scalar
add_weight_column_to_sampleframe: add a new weight column to a SampleFrame with optional provenance metadata
get_covars_view_from_sampleframe: get a BalanceDFCovars analysis view from a SampleFrame for covariate analysis
